about_short_description.short_description: Voltron Data develops data access and in-memory computing tools to improve the existing data analytics ecosystem.

product.name: Theseus SQL Engine
product.description: A GPU-accelerated, distributed SQL engine designed for AI workloads and large-scale data processing, enabling fast execution of complex queries on data lakes, lakehouses, and warehouses.

product.name: Theseus Control Plane
product.description: A Kubernetes-native management platform for deploying, scaling, and securing Theseus clusters across cloud environments with integrated monitoring and compliance features.

product.name: Theseus Query Profiler
product.description: A GPU-aware, low-overhead performance monitoring tool that provides real-time visualization and analysis of query execution across CPU, GPU, and I/O layers in Theseus clusters.
